description:
Hushfacebook v0.8.0 targets Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release, and 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 still work.

This release gathers everything since v0.7.2 and brings 85 patches, up from 70. Chats get Hide read receipts, Hide typing indicator and original quality photos and videos, any photo you open can be saved, and Home can open on the Following feed. Reels get a Download row in their More sheet, reel ads are stopped where Facebook's newer loader adds them, and new switches hide seen posts, Meta AI comment summaries, Meta upsells and tab badges.

Validation: 2276 runtime tests passed locally. All 820 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 85 patches applied to Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, build 475215365, or its 32-bit build 475215364. Builds 580.0.0.51.74 (475019344) and 577.0.0.50.72 (474426275) still work. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
